item.title: SNP Seeks Urgent Commons Update on Escalating Iran Crisis
item.description: SNP Foreign Affairs spokesperson Stephen Gethins has called for an urgent Commons update on the escalating Iran conflict, urging the UK Government to clarify its legal position and outline plans for de-escalation and diplomacy.The post SNP Seeks Urgent Commons Update on Escalating Iran Crisis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Ground Floor Home in The Heart of Salen on Mull
item.description: Located in the village of Salen on the Isle of Mull, 1 Morvern View is a three bedroom ground floor flat with garden and detached brick shed, offering practical island living in a central and well connected setting.The post A Ground Floor Home in The Heart of Salen on Mull appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Double Gold Glory for Ardnamurchan High School
item.description: Ardnamurchan High School in Lochaber has secured both a Gold School Sport Award from sportscotland and Gold Shinty School status, recognising its commitment to sport, wellbeing and strong community partnerships.The post Double Gold Glory for Ardnamurchan High School appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Interchange Plans Open for Public Feedback
item.description: Highland Council has opened a public consultation on plans for a new multi modal transport interchange in Inverness Station Quarter, with feedback invited until 10 April 2026 and a drop in event on 11 March. The post Inverness Interchange Plans Open for Public Feedback appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Tax Changes are Driving up Prices in Scotland
item.description: The SNP says new analysis shows Labour’s changes to National Insurance are increasing costs for Scottish businesses and driving up prices, calling on the UK Government to reverse what it describes as a tax on jobs.The post Labour Tax Changes are Driving up Prices in Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Moray Unites After Record Wildfires To Build Stronger Defences
item.description: Public and private sector leaders in Moray have pledged closer collaboration after record wildfires in 2025, beginning work on an Integrated Wildfire Management Plan to protect communities, landscapes and local livelihoods.The post Moray Unites After Record Wildfires To Build Stronger Defences appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Isle of Bute Puts Itself Forward to Become UK Town of Culture
item.description: Argyll and Bute Council has agreed to submit the Isle of Bute as its bid for UK Town of Culture 2028, with the island competing in the small town category for a chance to secure up to £3 million in funding.The post Isle of Bute Puts Itself Forward to Become UK Town of Culture appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: CalMac Opens Doors to The Next Generation of Island Mariners
item.description: CalMac has opened applications for its modern apprentice scheme, offering engine and deck rating roles with training at City of Glasgow Nautical College and on vessels serving island communities across the west coast.The post CalMac Opens Doors to The Next Generation of Island Mariners appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Homes With Open Views at Torvean in Inverness
item.description: Torvean on Golf View Road in Inverness offers 114 new homes from Robertson Homes, including three to six bedroom properties overlooking Kings Golf Course, close to the Great Glen Way and just ten minutes from the city centre.The post New Homes With Open Views at Torvean in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Claims of Khamenei Death Spark Global Shock and Uncertainty
item.description: Reports from Iran claim Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in coordinated US and Israeli airstrikes on 28 February 2026, triggering regional instability, internet blackouts and global concern over escalation and political uncertainty.The post Claims of Khamenei Death Spark Global Shock and Uncertainty appeared first on The Highland Times.
